The '''''Pillage''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] owned by [[Larken]]. The vessel was used alongside fellow [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] ships ''[[Trust Me]]'' and [[Profit (pirate ship)|''Profit'']] during an attempt to capture the [[Helix-class light interceptor|Helix-class]] [[Interceptor/Legends|light interceptor]] ''[[Kizbon's Box]]''. The operation, which took place at [[Darknon Station]] under cover of a magnetic storm, failed when the ''Kizbon's Box'' revealed hidden armaments that destroyed ''Trust Me'' and ''Profit''.<ref name="ABGTAS" />
